item.title: Fayette County man is running for State Senate
item.description: Fayette County, WV (WOAY) – A Fayette County chiropractor and minister is running for state senate in the tenth district. Robert Shirley Love is the grandson of Shirley Love, the longtime WOAY broadcaster and lawmaker. Love says his campaign will focus on the needs of everyday West Virginians.
